title: Agree
alt: Two children face each other, smiling and giving thumbs up.
scene: Two diverse children face each other, both nodding gently with calm smiles and both giving thumbs up at their sides. Equal height, nobody instructing.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Square single concept composition. Two diverse children face each other, both nodding gently with calm smiles and both giving thumbs up at their sides. Equal height, nobody instructing. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
